course_title: Advanced Software Testing and Quality Assurance
description: This course covers advanced software testing methodologies including test case design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, and state transition testing; automated testing frameworks like Selenium, JUnit, and TestNG; quality assurance standards such as ISO 9001 and CMMI; defect tracking systems like JIRA and Bugzilla; and performance testing tools like JMeter and LoadRunner. Topics also include test automation strategies, continuous integration practices, and code coverage analysis using tools like JaCoCo and lcov. The course emphasizes practical application of these concepts through hands-on lab exercises and real-world case studies.

clos.text: Define test case design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, and state transition testing.
Describe the architecture and components of automated testing frameworks like Selenium, JUnit, and TestNG.
Explain quality assurance standards such as ISO 9001 and CMMI and their application in software development processes.
Apply defect tracking systems like JIRA and Bugzilla in managing software quality throughout the development lifecycle.
Implement performance testing using tools like JMeter and LoadRunner to evaluate system scalability and reliability.
